sonnet.problem: The question says "Ahithophel tells Absalom he seeks the life of only one man." In 2 Samuel 17:3 Ahithophel says "You seek the life of only one man," so it is Absalom who seeks it. The wording is wrong, and "he" could be read as Ahithophel, which misstates the text.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. ... "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.
